title: DOW-UAP-D083, Narrative Statement 5, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This is a memorandum for record from the Department of War containing first-hand accounts of UAP sightings by federal law enforcement agents; the document records the claims without providing an official stance on their nature.

encounters.summary: Federal law enforcement agents observed a large orange light hovering over a ridge line at sunset.
encounters.quote: The orange light appeared to be placed on something, although nothing could be identified to be holding it up.

encounters.summary: Agents observed a large red orb releasing smaller red orbs, followed by a white flash of light.
encounters.quote: I am certain I saw two red, smaller orbs release from the larger one going west

encounters.summary: Agents observed a red and white light pair hovering over bushes, which later appeared as a thin horizontal line in NVGs.
encounters.quote: The red and white light pair hovered, with zero resistance, or change in height

encounters.summary: Agents observed a formation of faint lights moving in a way that suggested evasion, accompanied by physical ground markings.
physical_effects: symmetrical and round sharp cuts in the dirt
encounters.quote: The sharp cut in the dirt was symmetrical and round, but did not always make a full circle.
